label: Crowdie
note: Traditional skim-milk cheese of the Highlands and Islands; Gruth dhu (black crowdie) is crowdie mixed with double cream and rolled in oatmeal and black pepper; Hramsa has wild garlic

about.text: Crowdie (Gaelic gruth) is a soft, fresh, crumbly Scottish cheese that crofters made from the skim milk left after taking the cream for butter. It is a lactic cheese: the milk sours by itself and the curd is warmed, drained in a cloth and salted, sometimes with a little cream.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: pasteurised milk acidified with lactic acid (Wikipedia)
back to the Viking era and possibly the Picts (Wikipedia); home production declined after WWII; commercial since the 1960s via Susannah Stone, Tain
